sc: Toddler, fever 39 °C, refuses to stand, hip flexed and externally rotated → Septic arthritis
Well boy 6 yr, limp a week after a cold, still bears weight → Transient synovitis
Obese boy 13 yr, knee pain, leg rolls out when the hip is flexed → SCFE
f: Limp or refusal to walk · fever (septic) · night pain, pallor, bruising (leukaemia) · knee pain from the hip
Hot swollen joint, any movement very painful (septic) · point tenderness over bone (osteomyelitis) · ↓ abduction + internal rotation (Perthes)
Septic arthritis · transient synovitis · Perthes · SCFE · leukaemia
CBC, ESR, CRP, blood culture · hip ultrasound · joint aspiration · frog-leg X-ray (SCFE) · MRI (early osteomyelitis)
Septic: drain + IV cloxacillin + ceftriaxone, about 3 wk · synovitis: rest, NSAID · SCFE: urgent pinning
Kocher: T > 38.5 °C · ESR > 40 · WBC > 12 000 · no weight bearing (3–4 = septic)
trap: Knee pain with a normal knee → examine the hip · osteomyelitis in sickle cell → Salmonella · the X-ray stays normal for the first 10–14 days of osteomyelitis
